brief: A tool rack that hangs on a wall from keyhole hangers, with hooks for small hand tools.

requirements.requirement: Tool rack that hangs on wall from keyhole hangers
requirements.evidence: Keyhole hangers (hex-acc-keyhole) on rear slot 4 of all three cells (-1,0,0; 0,0,0; 1,0,0) – 3 hangers total
Hook plates (hex-acc-hook) on front slot 1 of all three cells – 6 hooks total

finish.summary: 3-cell horizontal rack: keyhole hangers on rear for wall mounting and hook plates on front for hand tools. Mesh clear.

lines.label: M6 x 20 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.

- **Hooks for small hand tools:** met – Hook plates (each with two hooks) installed on front face (slot 1) of all three cells, providing 6 hooks total for hand tools
